meta.reason=Contract pin P7 for mu-On, first recording: host blocks above the prepared size (ragged 1024 and oversize 4096/2048 on a 512 preparation). Before E3.6 the old processor chain rendered only the prepared part of such a block and the mixer overran its prepared buffers, so no segment could be recorded; since E3.6 the shared driver chunks every block into calls of at most the prepared size (C8, design 2.1.6 point 10). This is the expected result of the C8 chunking contract, not a behaviour change of any existing golden: every other mu-on golden passed unchanged at E3.6 and is untouched here.
